# Obsidian Spec-to-Implementation Reference

Consult this reference when obsidian spec-to-implementation reference is relevant to the selected task. Extract the specific constraint or example you need, verify version-sensitive behavior against the active toolchain, and return to the task rather than loading unrelated references.

## Suggested plan sections

- Goals / non-goals
- Requirements

- Architecture notes
- Action items
- Validation
- Risks
